intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin designed to simplify section selection with a single hotkey.
motivation: To simplify the selection process and overcome challenges with cursor control on mobile devices.
problem: Mobile users often struggle with precise cursor control and visibility when attempting to select text in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: For line-by-line selection, use the Code Shortcuts plugin with the hotkey Cmd-L.

summary: A selection tool that expands the current cursor selection to lines, sections, or the entire note using hotkeys, primarily for mobile convenience.
